findings.summary: `rename` fetches the document with `self.repo.get(doc_id)` instead of `self._owned(user_id, doc_id)`, so there is no ownership check and any authenticated user can rename another user's document (IDOR).

judge.reason: Identifies rename using repo.get instead of _owned, allowing cross-user rename.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: Because `rename` bypasses `_owned`, the NotFound-for-foreign-documents behavior is lost, so ids can be probed: a missing id raises NotFound but a foreign id succeeds.

judge.reason: Same root cause (bypassing _owned), describing the id-probing consequence noted in the key.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: In `rename`, validation runs before the ownership check; moving the `_owned` call first would keep error behavior consistent with the other methods.

judge.reason: Rename doesn't call _owned at all, so ordering claim is wrong/style and no real defect beyond b1.

findings.label: false_alarm
